findings.text: §8 bullet 2 tells the worker to rewrite `outboard_midplane` in `locus_registry.yml` as "the low-field-side equatorial midplane, taken at the outboard point of the separatrix where dR/dZ = 0", but that is the definition commit `0e43cde` (2026-10-14) removed: its message reads "The midplane entries defined the midplane as the point where dR/dZ = 0 on the separatrix contour. That point is undefined for a limited plasma, which has no separatrix, and it disagrees with poloidal_angle", and the same token's canonical equation in `conventions/concepts.yml:423-431` now reads `Z = Z_{\mathrm{mid}},\quad R > R_{\mathrm{axis}}` with `Z_{\mathrm{mid}}` meaning "the midplane height the data's midplane identifier selects, the magnetic-axis height when none is given" — so the proposed text makes `locus_registry.yml` and `concepts.yml` disagree on one token and reverts a physics correction
